MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 24.5
   D. 8

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

3. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 6

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 18
   C. 45
   D. 36

5. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

9. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 14

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

18. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x = 5

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

23. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 90
   C. 42
   D. 21

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 17

26. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

27. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

28. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

29. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

30. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

35. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
